description: This source file defines structures, enums, and functions related to discovering wide-area gateways in a Tailscale/Tailscale-like network environment using DNS Service Discovery (DNS-SD) and various network probing techniques. It includes functionality to parse Tailscale status, perform DNS queries via dig, and assemble gateway beacon information.

classes.name: WideAreaGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Represents a discovered wide-area gateway with properties such as instance name, display name, host, port, LAN host, tailnet DNS, gateway port, SSH port, and CLI path.

classes.name: DiscoveryContext
classes.description: Holds closures for obtaining Tailscale status and performing DNS dig queries, facilitating testability and dependency injection.

classes.name: TailscaleStatus
classes.description: Decodable model representing the JSON structure of the Tailscale status output.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Performs network discovery of wide-area gateways within a specified timeout and context, returning an array of WideAreaGatewayBeacon objects.

methods.name: collectTailnetIPv4s
methods.description: Extracts IPv4 addresses associated with the local Tailscale tailnet from the Tailscale status JSON.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to read the current Tailscale status by invoking potential Tailcale executable paths.

methods.name: loadWideAreaPtrRecords
methods.description: Performs DNS PTR record lookup for the wide-area gateway service domain, returning trimmed domain and PTR lines if successful.

methods.name: runDig
methods.description: Executes the 'dig' command with given arguments and timeout, returning the output string.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a process with specified executable path, arguments, and timeout, capturing and returning its standard output.

methods.name: parseSrv
methods.description: Parses SRV record output string into host and port components.

methods.name: parseTxtTokens
methods.description: Parses TXT record lines into key-value string tokens, handling DNS escapes.

methods.name: decodeDnsSdEscapes
methods.description: Decodes DNS-SD escaped characters within TXT tokens.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Converts optional string to an integer if parsable.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Determines if a string is an IPv4 address within the specific tailnet range.
